Heard Sri Rajareddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others

328 IPC and under Sections 59 (I) of Food Safety and Standard Act-2006, are hereby quashed.

Order:
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against him, in FIR No.190 of 2019, on the file of Buchireddypalem Police Station, Sri Potti Sri Ramulu Nellore District.
The offences alleged are under Sections 272, 273, 328 IPC and under Sections 56(I) of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
